DESCRIPCIÓN DEL CARGO Buscamos a un Gerente de Pricing y Revenue que combine pensamiento analítico, criterio de negocio y capacidad de influencia para acelerar la adopción de estrategias de fijación de precios con nuestros clientes. Conocimiento sólido de forecasting, segmentación de mercado, evaluación de demanda y revenue optimization. Description: Why Join Ford of Mexico? Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal), with the ability to clearly document engineering models, specifications, and technical reports. Even better, you may have... Description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. What we're missing is a senior technical voice to make the foundational calls — architecture, platform, governance, ML Ops — so that speed compounds instead of accumulating debt. That's this role, and it comes with unusual latitude to decide how the platform should work. How You'll Make an Impact As our Tech Lead Data Engineer & Data Architect , you will shape the technical direction, architectural standards, and data governance of our core Data Analytics platform. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will act as our Data Architect—owning logical and physical data modeling, warehouse design, and layered curation (staging → intermediate → mart)—while serving as our Data Engineering Tech Lead. You will help continuously modernize our tech stack, elevating our software engineering discipline across our data pipelines (DataOps/CI-CD), optimizing compute performance and costs, driving MLOps workflows, and reinforcing data quality and security standards. Crucially, you will drive our AI-readiness initiatives—architecting the semantic layers, data structures, and access patterns needed to make our data seamless and reliable for AI agents and automated workflows. You will serve as the technical anchor for a talented team of Analytical Engineers, collaborating closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Data Science / ML and business stakeholders to ensure our data ecosystem is reliable, scalable, and business-ready. Own data model design across data products and marts, implementing flexible dimensional models (Star Schemas, SCDs, conformed dimensions) and documenting decisions through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). Data Engineering Competency: Lead the end-to-end design and execution of data pipelines—owning ingestion, API integrations, custom connectors, ELT/ETL processes, and pipeline orchestration. DataOps & CI/CD Integration: Build upon our existing Git, CI/CD, and Jira workflows by embedding specialized data discipline—such as automated dbt testing on pull requests, environment isolation, automated credential management, and data deployment standards. Governance & Observability Strategy: Build upon and refine the initial foundations of our governance model. Evaluate, select, and implement scalable Data Catalog and Data Observability solutions to track data lineage, ensure freshness, monitor completeness, and automate failure alerting. Platform Efficiency & Cost Control: Continuously tune Snowflake query performance, clustering, and warehouse sizing to optimize execution times and compute spend. Technical Mentorship & Agile Leadership: Raise the technical effectiveness of Analytical Engineers within our Agile planning framework through architectural guidance, design reviews, and constructive challenge. Stack Modernization & Architecture Evolution: Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and architecture patterns to modernize, optimize, and add flexibility to our data stack. What Sets You Up for Success Senior Hands-On Experience: Proven track record as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Tech Lead in cloud data environments. AI & Agent Readiness: Exposure to preparing data structures, semantic models, feature stores, and API/access layers for AI agents, machine learning pipelines, and automated LLM workflows. Snowflake & dbt Mastery: Deep hands-on expertise administering, tuning, and modeling in Snowflake , alongside advanced mastery of dbt (macros, incremental models, custom tests, packages, and dbt-native CI/CD testing). Advanced SQL & Python Skills: Expert analytical SQL skills (query execution plan tuning, window functions, CTEs) and strong Python proficiency for data pipelines, scripting, and MLOps workflows. Orchestration & Tool Evaluation: Practical experience with ingestion and orchestration engines (e.g., Matillion, Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Fivetran), with a strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, performance, and costs when selecting or migrating platforms. DataOps & Software Engineering Discipline: Experience operating with active Git and CI/CD pipelines, with a track record of extending these systems to include automated data testing, deployment validation, and secure credential rotation. Critical Thinking & Problem Decomposition: Tendency to question assumptions, gather full business context, form hypotheses, and rigorously evaluate outputs (especially for AI/ML outputs) before jumping to technical solutions. Pragmatic Experimentation: Passion for building lightweight MVPs and Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate new technologies, test architectural hypotheses, and modernize the data stack. Communication & Technical Influence: Business-level English fluency with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs clearly, mentor teammates, and collaborate effectively in a remote, globally distributed team. Bonus Skills to Stand Out Exposure to applied AI tooling (Snowflake Cortex, AI Classify, RAG workflows, LLM agents, MCP servers). Familiarity with modern BI consumption tools like Sigma or workflow engines like n8n . Description: Description This role plays a critical role in shaping Amazon's Middle Mile transportation strategy while delivering a best-in-class customer promise. This position balances multi-year network strategy with the analytical rigor required to direct a network that operates every day. This position is the single-threaded owner of Amazon's Middle Mile transportation strategy across Mexico, leading network design, transit time, analytics and procurement across multiple transportation products. This role owns how the network is designed, how fast we commit to be, what we pay for capacity and which programs we invest in, end to end from Fulfillment Centers and Sort Centers through to the final hand-off to Last Mile. The successful candidate will lead a diverse organization responsible for Cross-Network Transportation Strategy, Network Design and Capacity Planning, Transit Time and Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), Network Analytics and Transportation Procurement, as well as the strategy layer of every transportation program in Middle Mile including Sub-Same-Day, Linehaul, Warehouse Transfers, Third Party Carrier (3PC), Partner Carrier Program (PCP) and Direct Injection, We-Pay, External Fulfillment, Vendor Returns (VRETs), Reusable Containers and 1P Fleet, plus future strategic initiatives. This role sets the plan; the Middle Mile operating organizations execute it. The role therefore partners closely with Transportation Operations, Sort Center Operations, Supply Chain, Last Mile, Finance, Procurement, Product, Tech, ACES and Global Transportation teams to build scalable transportation solutions supporting Amazon's long-term growth, and depends on influence and alignment rather than direct authority over execution. This leader combines strong business judgment, analytical rigor and executive communication skills to influence senior stakeholders, drive organizational alignment and define the long-term roadmap for Amazon's Middle Mile transportation network. Key job responsibilities Own the multi-year transportation strategy for Middle Mile Mexico, balancing Cost, Speed, Capacity and Customer Experience. Own the annual network plan and the quarterly capacity commit: node footprint, lane design, mode mix and 1P versus 3P. Own the transit time promise and DEA across the network, including methodology, targets and governance. Own transportation procurement: carrier sourcing, contracts, rate cards and cost per unit. Own the strategy and multi-year roadmap of every Middle Mile transportation program, handing each roadmap to the operating organizations to execute. Own the single source of truth for network speed and cost, including the scorecard and the KPIs leadership uses to judge the network: Cost per Unit, Transit Time, DEA, Capacity Utilization, Carrier Performance and Productivity (TU). Own OP1, OP2, headcount planning and investment proposals for transportation, in partnership with Finance. Build the mechanisms that keep strategy and execution aligned, and lead executive business reviews that land decisions with senior leadership. Hire, develop and mentor a team of Program Managers and Analysts, and raise the analytical bar of the organization. A day in the life No two days look the same. You start with the network scorecard, diagnosing whether a metric miss is noise, a capacity constraint, or a flawed plan, then directing your lead to investigate. Mid-morning you pressure-test assumptions in a capacity commit session, leaving with a number you'll defend to leadership and Finance. You review a carrier RFP, weighing strong rates against volume commitments that conflict with the 18-month network plan. You shape a Direct Injection expansion with the operating org in the room, pushing for a smaller first phase with cleaner results. You close the day writing plans, OP inputs, investment one-pagers. Some weeks tilt toward planning; others toward firefighting. Both are the job.
